Billing System - User Guide
=======================

1. INSTALLATION
   - No installation required! This is a portable application.
   - Copy the entire folder to your desired location (e.g., your pendrive or local computer).

2. RUNNING THE APPLICATION
   - Double-click on "SaleBillSystem.NET.exe" to start the application.
   - On first run, you'll be prompted to create an admin user.

3. DATABASE LOCATION
   - By default, the database will be created in the same folder as the application.
   - To use a different database location:
     a. Go to Tools > Settings in the menu
     b. Click "Browse" next to the Database Path field
     c. Select your desired location
     d. Click Save

4. USING EXTERNAL/EXISTING DATABASE
   - If you have an existing database:
     a. Go to Tools > Load Database
     b. Browse to your existing database file
     c. Select the file and click Open
   - Or to create a new database in a specific location:
     a. Go to Tools > Create New Database
     b. Browse to the location where you want to create the database
     c. Enter a filename and click Save

5. LICENSE ACTIVATION
   - This software requires license activation.
   - See LICENSE_INSTRUCTIONS.txt for detailed steps on how to activate your license.
   - The license is tied to the specific machine it's activated on.

6. SUPPORT
   - For technical support, please contact your system administrator or vendor.

Thank you for using our Billing System!
